mapper.sql: select a.id, a.equipment_id, a.register_count, a.available_count, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from d_loan_register a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.equipment_id, a.register_count, a.available_count, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, de.name as equipmentName, de.equ_no as equipmentCode from d_loan_register a left join d_equipment de on a.equipment_id = de.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} and a.register_count = #{registerCount} and a.available_count = #{availableCount} and a.status = #{status}
and de.name like concat('%', #{equipmentName}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update d_loan_register set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
